name: Yellow Sapphire Hotel: The Little Tales Of
summary: Yellow Sapphire Hotel is an alternative version from Sapphire Hotel. Introducing a lovey yellow pallet to the game but this version goes a lot further then just a color swap! Designed with the insight from BeatScribe, Yellow Sapphire is the most accessible for people of all ages! Even though Sapphire Hotel is meant to be played by everyone, this version has turned the cutesy to the max! There’s so many changes, even if you’ve played Sapphire Hotel before, you will find plenty of new things to enjoy!
